history_note_reviews.title: Community Continuity And Reorganization
history_note_reviews.meaning: Own history updated in 2022 supports land loss, reclassification, family continuity, February 2002 reorganization and May 2002 elections. Final wording distinguishes a government reorganization from the beginning of a people and explicitly preserves the other Nottoway community. No intertribal polemic or legal recognition inference adopted.

history_note_reviews.title: Language Records And Public Learning
history_note_reviews.meaning: Own pages support 1820 and 1830s vocabulary records, correspondence and bilingual public interpretation. Wording clearly excludes current speakers, classes, opening times and measured outcomes. No sacred vocabulary or colonial derogatory classification reproduced.
